title: cochlearia orientalis
intro: Cochlearia orientalis, commonly known as Oriental Borage or Oriental Rocket, is a perennial plant in the Brassicaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Cochlearia orientalis include its use as an expectorant to relieve coughs and congestion, as well as its potential to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Cochlearia orientalis include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
